title: committee_transfer
description: One committee's money to another committee or a candidate: a receipt from another committee, as the recipient reports it, or a committee's contribution to a candidate, as the giver reports it. A gift is often reported on both sides, so sum one `side` only. Committee money, never a contribution. Partitioned by cycle.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

source_record_id.description: The FEC's id of the row (`SUB_ID`), unique within a source.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

from_committee_id.description: The FEC id of the committee the money came from.

to_committee_id.description: The FEC id of the committee it went to.

candidate_id.description: The FEC id of the candidate the receiving committee raises for, when it is their principal or authorized committee. For a 24K to a committee linked to no candidate, the candidate the giver names, when that is a candidate of the cycle. Else null.

amount.description: The amount in dollars, as filed. A void or refund is negative and nets out in any sum.

date.description: The date as filed; null when the filer gave none.

side.description: `receipt` when the recipient reported it, `disbursement` when the giver did (a 24K contribution to a candidate).
